* This class is for handling temporary failure. * *

Receiving a TEMPORARY_FAILURE is caused by a temporary condition. IKE Session should be * closed if it continues to receive this error after several minutes.

methods.name: public void handleTempFailure()
methods.comment:
* Schedule temporary failure timeout. * *

Caller of this method is responsible for scheduling retry of the rejected request.

methods.name: public void reset()
methods.comment: Stop tracking temporary condition when request was not rejected by TEMPORARY_FAILURE.
